newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-LEADING GERMAN FIRST DIVISION GOALSCORERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LEADING GERMAN FIRST DIVISION GOALSCORERS.

text.p: Leading goalscorers in the Bundesliga on Saturday after 16 matches:
10 - Ulf Kirsten (Bayer Leverkusen), Paulo Sergio (Bayer Leverkusen), Martin Max (Schalke), Fredi Bobic (VfB Stuttgart), Giovane Elber (VfB Stuttgart)
9 - Andreas Herzog (Werder Bremen), Bernhard Winkler (1860 Munich), Jonathan Akpoborie (Hansa Rostock)
7 - Bruno Labbadia (Werder Bremen), Ion Vladoiu (Cologne), Krasimir Balakov (VfB Stuttgart)
